_readme: Single source of truth for the shop. scripts/shop.mjs builds the shop page, every product page and the homepage block from this file.
Every product starts with detailsStatus and imagesStatus set to 'sample'. Replace the text/numbers/images, then set them to 'confirmed'.

The build REFUSES to publish the shop as live (site.config.json shopStatus = 'live') unless: registrationStatus is 'registered', every product is 'confirmed' for details and images, and every product has a checkoutUrl.
To change a price, edit price and the costs below; the 'left for RallyGood' figure is calculated automatically.
Images live in src/assets/shop/. To swap a photo, drop the new file in that folder and change the image path/alt here.

groups.title: Core range
groups.blurb: Our everyday RallyGood pieces. These will always be part of the shop.

groups.title: Drop editions
groups.blurb: Limited, time-boxed items linked to a specific Drop. Art first, logo second.

groups.title: £10 and under
groups.blurb: Small, easy ways to show support, and good add-ons to any order.

delivery: UK standard delivery £3.95 per order; free UK delivery on orders of £60 or more.
Items printed to order are dispatched separately from stocked items, so they may arrive in more than one parcel.
International delivery is not planned at launch.
returns: You can cancel within 14 days of receiving your order and then have a further 14 days to send it back. We refund the item price and standard delivery.
If something arrives faulty or damaged, contact us and we will repair, replace or refund it.
These are your statutory rights and they apply whatever else we say.
policies.donation: Buying merchandise is not a donation and is not eligible for Gift Aid. If we offer an optional donation at checkout it will be a separate, clearly labelled amount.
